tags: SDRL218 Deltana round pocket door privacy set

text.description_html:
Deltana SDRL218 Round Privacy Pocket Door Set

This round pocket door privacy set has a contemporary look and comes complete with finger pull to pull the door from the pocket to close. It is easy to install in a standard pre-drilled door with a 2-3/8" backset and comes with all installation hardware. Normally used when a pre-drilled door is installed as a sliding pocket door and the door needs to be locked for privacy such as on a bathroom or bedroom. Available in polished chrome, satin nickel, or oil rubbed bronze finishes to complement any design. Adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 2 inches.

Privacy Function (bedroom or bathroom): can be used on any pocket door that you may need to lock like a bedroom or bathroom door. Turning the thumb turn on the inside unlocks and locks the pocket door. Turning the emergency lock on the outside releases the latch and unlocks the door. Can also be used to lock double pocket doors.

Also available non-locking passage function. Deltana Round Pocket Door Passage Set.

Specifications for the Deltana Round Pocket Door Privacy Set

  • Door Prep: 2-1/8" face bore, 1" edge bore.
  • Finger Pull Prep: 1" bore
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" or 2"
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" square corner
  • Strike: 1" x 2-5/8" square corner with dust box
  • Fasteners: M4 phillips drive
  • Packaged complete with all installation hardware.
  • SDRL218 Installation Instructions (PDF)
  • SDRL218 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
